title: The Smuggler's Pension
logline: An aging smuggler wants to do one last massive run to fund their retirement, but their protégé plans to steal the cargo.

roles.description: Cynical, physically failing, trusting only one person.
Ambitious, impatient, believes the old ways are dead.
A remote orbital platform used for discreet handoffs.
A loose network of independent runners.

public_situation: A massive shipment of highly regulated medical supplies has 'fallen off a transport'.
private_truth: The old smuggler orchestrated the theft for their retirement fund, but the protégé has sold them out to a rival cartel.

beats.public_change: The old smuggler begins liquidating their local assets.

missions.reason: Needs specialized containment crates delivered to secure the medical cargo.
missions.private_fact: The old smuggler is too sick to fly their own ship right now.

missions.reason: Needs secure routing tables delivered to the drop station to mask their approach.
missions.private_fact: The tables will also erase the station's backup logs to cover their tracks.

beats.public_change: Authorities announce a sector-wide scan for the stolen medicine.

missions.reason: Needs ferrite plating delivered to reinforce the smuggling compartments.
missions.private_fact: The protégé is actually building a trap to lock the old smuggler in the cargo bay.

beats.public_change: The old smuggler vanishes from public comms.

missions.reason: Needs the pilot to scan the drop station for signs of an ambush before they dock.
missions.private_fact: They suspect the protégé's betrayal but don't want to believe it.

beats.public_change: The rival cartel's ships arrive at the drop station.

missions.reason: The protégé demands the pilot deliver the final nav coordinates to the rivals.
missions.private_fact: The protégé intends to kill the pilot once the deal is done.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the nav coordinates and must choose a side.

options.label: Give the coordinates to the protégé
Warn the old smuggler and withhold coordinates

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot warns the old smuggler.
resolutions.summary: The old smuggler escapes with the cargo and retires, leaving the protégé to face the angry rivals.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the coordinates to the protégé.
resolutions.summary: The protégé steals the cargo and the old smuggler is arrested. A new, ruthless smuggler takes over.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the setup missions.
resolutions.summary: The heist falls apart. The authorities recover the medicine, and both smugglers are ruined.

loose_threads.detail: The stolen medical crates have their serial numbers replaced with deep-core mining codes.
The rival cartel was receiving tactical updates on encrypted diplomatic channels.

radio_hooks: Massive theft of medical supplies reported.
Authorities warn of increased smuggling activity in the sector.

voice_direction.protege: Slick, fast-talking, entirely focused on the future.
